items.name: canadianhighlander.ca
items.description: The format's home, run by the Canlander Council. Rules, history, and every points update announcement.

items.name: The Points List
items.description: The current list of pointed cards and their costs. Bookmark it. It changes a few times a year.

items.name: Rules & Format History
items.description: Deck construction rules, the extra bans on top of Vintage, and how the format grew out of Victoria in 1999.

items.name: Council Articles
items.description: Points update announcements with the council's reasoning, plus survey reports.

items.name: Vintage Banned & Restricted List
items.description: Canlander builds on the Vintage list. Restricted cards play like any other card here.

items.name: Canadian Highlander Discord
items.description: The main community server. Weekly Cockatrice and webcam events, deck help, points-update discussion.

items.name: Canadian Highlander Facebook Group
items.description: The long-running Facebook group. Good for local event posts and trades.

items.name: North 100 Showdown
items.description: LoadingReadyRun's gameplay series: over a hundred full matches with commentary. The best-produced and biggest collection of Canlander games there is.

items.name: Canadian Highlander on YouTube
items.description: The format's YouTube channel: gameplay and event coverage.

items.name: North 100 (podcast)
items.description: LoadingReadyRun's Canlander podcast, running since 2017. Set reviews, deck techs, points-list talk.

items.name: LJT MTG
items.description: Liam, Jer and Trent (now on the council) making Canadian Highlander videos: gameplay, brews and more.

items.name: What is Canadian Highlander? (LRR)
items.description: A short video explainer from LoadingReadyRun. Send it to the friend you're trying to recruit.

items.name: Introduction to Canadian Highlander
items.description: Wizards of the Coast's 2016 feature that introduced a lot of players to the format. The points have changed since then, but it's still a good intro.

items.name: Hipsters of the Coast Primer
items.description: A friendly primer with good advice on brewing and bringing the format to your playgroup.

items.name: Draftsim Format Guide
items.description: A thorough overview of rules, the points system, and common archetypes.

items.name: Canlander Winner's Archive
items.description: Winning decklists from Canlander events, collected on Moxfield. The best place to find a proven list to start from.

items.name: Canlandex
items.description: Search decks, events and card stats, see the common point spreads for each archetype, and get deck suggestions based on your collection.

items.name: Paper Canadian Highlander Games
items.description: A community Google Sheet of in-person Canlander game nights by city: store, day, time, organizer and proxy rules.

items.name: MTGDecks: Canadian Highlander
items.description: The biggest results archive: weeklies, store events, and majors, with metagame breakdowns.

items.name: Moxfield
items.description: Has Canadian Highlander as a format and shows your points total and legality as you build.

items.name: MTGGoldfish
items.description: Deck editor supports Canadian Highlander and checks points automatically.

items.name: Scryfall
items.description: The best card search there is. You'll live here while brewing a 100-card singleton deck.

items.name: Discord video
items.description: Webcam games on the Discord run over its built-in video calls. Join the server, find an opponent, and play with your own cards or proxies.

items.name: Cockatrice
items.description: Free, open-source client with every card. The Discord's Cockatrice weekly and league run here.
